title: Solana Wallet HUD v0.2 Scene Strength and Multi-Scenario Evaluation
objective: Implement Wallet HUD v0.2 for the 32 SOL candidate addresses based on Wallet HUD v0.1: primary and secondary scene classification across 5 first-edition scenes (MULTI_TOKEN_REPEATABILITY, PAYOFF_ASYMMETRY, ACTIVITY_PERSISTENCE, HIGH_FREQUENCY_SIGNAL_VALUE, TRANSFER_ACCOUNTING_RISK), same-scene strength score and percentile (Pxx suppressed when peer_n < 10), peer_n and effective sample count, evidence tier/confidence, recent trend, followability status, full and incremental GMGN notes export, and HUD status/tag change history. Process strictly the 32 candidate addresses only; do not generate global total scores, global ranks, Alpha grades, S/SSR/EX, direct follow or heavy-position advice, or shadow-follow stats when shadow events = 0. Pure offline execution without network requests or background cron.
forbidden_actions: Do not issue live network requests to GMGN, Helius, Solana RPC, or any third party.
Do not read credentials or API keys.
Do not process addresses outside the 32 SOL candidate addresses.
Do not generate Pxx percentile when same-scene peer_n < 10.
Do not generate global overall wallet scores or global rankings.
Do not generate formal Alpha Score, UR/SSR/SR/S/EX grades, direct copy-trade recommendations, or heavy-position conclusions.
Do not generate simulated win rate, profit factor, latency, or follow percentile when shadow follow events equal 0.
Do not treat null values as 0.
Do not start background monitoring processes, cron jobs, or shadow follow daemons.
Do not commit private wallet addresses, raw GMGN transaction details, on-chain transactions, or chainfm_out files to Git.
Do not modify Operator Console, CA Hotpath, BSC, Robinhood, liquidity modules, or existing Alpha Score rules.
